title: Bay Street (Vesting) Act
text:
Supplement  to Official  Gazette No. 30 dated 26th March,  2009 

BAY  STREET  (VESTING)  ACT,  2009 - 

Arrangement  of Sections 

Section 

1.  Short title. 

2.  Vesting of land in the Crown. 

SCHEDULE 

 BARBADOS 

I assent 
C. STRAUGHN HUSBANDS 
Governor-General 
20th March, 2009. 

An  Act  to  vest a parcel  of  land situate at the Old Fish Market 

Site, Bay Street, in the parish  of Saint Michael  in the Crown. 

(26th March, 2009).  Commence- 

ment. 

ENACTED by the Parliament of Barbados as follows: 

1.  This Act  may be cited as the Bay Street (Vesting) Act, 2009.  Short  title. 

2.  From the date of  the commencement of this Act all that land  Vesting of 

described in the Schedule including any estate, right, title or interest in, to or 
over that land shall, by virtue of this Act, be vested in the Crown. 

Schedule. 

 BAY  STREET (VESTING) ACT, 2009 - 4 

SCHEDULE 

(Section 2) 

ALL  THAT land situate at Bay Street in the parish of  Saint Michael in this 
Island  containing  by  admeasurement  1984.4 square  metres  or  thereabouts 
(inclusive of  1409.4 square metres  of accreted  land)  abutting and  bounding on 
lands  now or late of  Christopher  Codrington  on  the  beach  on  lands  of 
the 
Barbados Government and on a road called Bay Street that leads to the Garrison 
in  one  direction  and  to  Bridgetown  in  the  other  direction  or  however  else  the 
same  may  abut and bound  as shown and  delineated on a plan  certified on the 
15th day of July, 2005 by Andrew R. Bourne, Land Surveyor and recorded in the 
Lands and Surveys Department as Plan No. 39912005.
